_comment: The Similar tab (components/similar/SimilarPanel.jsx): its words and its knobs; its name is in lib/tabs.js. The rules are in lib/similar.js; the pairs come from the backend's catalogue.
subtitle: Verses that read almost alike: see what tells them apart, then learn which wording is where
_comment-gap: A difference longer than this many words, on either side, is shown in Compare but never asked: past a short phrase it is a different passage to learn, not a wording to tell apart.
_comment-next: Twins that read word for word the same are told apart by what follows: Compare shows the next ayah of each, Drill asks for its first next-words words.
_comment-why: Why they differ: each differing word's meaning and role (the reader's word-by-word grammar), then each verse in the reader's translation and the chosen tafsir. Fetched only when opened. `tafsir` is the book used until a reader picks one in the Qur'an tab: a short per-ayah one, so the context is a line, not a chapter.
why: Why they differ: meaning and context
why-no-grammar: No word-by-word grammar for this verse.
why-no-tafsir: This book says nothing on this verse.
same: These two read word for word the same: what follows each is the tell.
question: Question {n} of {of}
passed: All correct: this pair is mastered.
slipped: Slips: {n}. Compare them again, then try once more.
no-drill: These two differ in whole passages rather than a word or two, and run on the same way, so there is nothing short to drill. Compare them instead.
none: No similar verses recorded for this surah.
error: Similar verses could not be read
fallback: They come from the Qur'an tab's own source.
